description: Handoff inputs from the MC-19 scope-proposal milestone to MC-20 (product catalog batch 1: NAV, HUB, AIS). MC-20 has not started and is not authorized by this document. The inputs record what MC-20 may rely on and what MC-19 did not deliver.

availableInputs.input: MC-17 design system (48 Angular components + 1 directive)
MC-18 bilingual landing patterns and isolated preview
MC-16 canonical product data contract and generated projection
MC-15 proposed route registry (23 routes, 9 family routes, 6 bundle routes)
MC-14 claims policy and release-evidence gates
MC-18 independent audit and delivery conclusions

mustNotAssume: MC-19 segment or solution pages exist; they do not.
Any public MAREA route exists; /marea and /en/marea are 404 in production.
Any price, stock, SKU, purchase or subscription capability exists; all products are NOT_FOR_SALE.
Any lead capture, enquiry form, contact endpoint or installer registration exists; the privacy gate is blocked.
Any trademark, public-use, source-IP, licensing or publication authorization exists.
Any MC-19 acceptance criterion is verified; D04 is a proposal.

missingInputs.input: Approved segment-page patterns and audience context

missingInputs.reason: MC-19 scope proposal leaves the boundary to the owner decision.
MC-18 conventions exist but no catalog-specific contract was added.

missingInputs.input: Shared SEO activation decision for future MAREA pages
missingInputs.reason: No route is activated or authorized.

mc20EntryConditions: MC-20 Master Prompt issued and bound to a scope revision.
MC-20 IA decision for the nine family pages, reusing MC-15 proposed routes and the MC-16 product data contract.
MC-17 design system and MC-18 landing patterns reused, not forked.
Every family page stays preview-only and non-indexable until the publication gates and a release authorization record exist.
No price, stock, SKU, purchase, lead or certification claim is introduced.
Inherited debt remains visible; FINANCIAL_V18 is still open.
nonAuthorization: This handoff does not start MC-20, does not assign MC-20 owners or dates and does not approve any MC-20 route, page, price or publication.
